iso-f2a.name: Behavioral Warning, try 2: his own third sentence back, his nickname in brackets after its don't
iso-f2a.text: This neural de-armoring protocol demands starving your brain of "Phasic" Dopamine, which works in the brain to produce learning and excitement when chasing novelty. The easiest way for most folks to take a break from that is to hole up alone. But don't isolate completely (the isolation trap), because that actually spikes cortisol, the chronic stress hormone. And cortisol sensitizes your brain to glutamate, thus locking the old neural armor in place that we're trying to gently remove. Calm company, like nature walk buddies, goes the other way, anchoring you via oxytocin, the bonding hormone. Good friends are ultimately more vital than any brain repair protocol.

agm-f2a.name: Agmatine warning, folded, its opening tied to the herbs the protocol leaves out
agm-f2a.text: Agmatine, the "voltage regulator", acts like a brake on NMDA/glutamate signaling, which is why we do use it in this protocol. But we'll keep it as an optional add-on, since it can interact with a lot more medications than the protocol's safer nutrients would (magnesium, phosphatidylcholine, etc.). People may think it's pretty safe, since it's a common health supplement, but we have to treat it with caution since it acts powerfully on imidazoline/alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, nitric-oxide pathways, and opioid reward/tolerance.
